text: Understanding databases is essential for modern software. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables with rows and columns, which makes them ideal for structured information. NoSQL databases are more flexible and suit unstructured or rapidly changing data. To work with data, we use queries, which are commands that let us retrieve and modify information. Good data modeling helps organise how data connects and stays consistent. Indexes also play an important role: they speed up searches by helping the database find information quickly. Choosing the right database and design improves performance and keeps applications reliable.
